review_description: From the initial call to Callan to the final instal of our ESS Alpha battery we couldn’t be happier. Whole process was completed in under 2 weeks. The guys on site were fantastic and did an incredible installDefinitely recommend the team at AR Energy

The quotation was quick. Once I signed and paid the deposit, I didn’t hear from them until I messaged them few weeks later. Anyway, the installers were very punctual and polite and showed me the procedure to shut down or bypass the battery if need to. However, it was discovered that some of the lights were not working later that night. As it was late Friday night, the issue wasn’t resolved until Tuesday morning. The guy who fixed the problem was very apologetic.

I can’t speak highly enough of Blake Shaw, your electrician in charge of our solar array and battery installation team. The lads were tidy, respectful and productively efficient. Blake was outstanding in talking me through the job, installing the monitoring app on my mobile phone and making sure I understood it all. What a task and so effortlessly executed.From the moment Kurtis Fraus, your initial contact, suggested we use our existing solar array and add extra solar panels and batteries, I knew we had a deal that would work for us.Even the office support staff worked seamlessly through the whole operation; a most impressive AR Energy team and we thank you for your professionalism.Malcolm & Annie
Very prompt service and competitive quote which was delivered quickly. The installation went smoothly, clean and professional staff. Very happy to recommend this company.

We had a fantastic experience with AR Energy. They were incredibly patient and took the time to understand our needs, ultimately customising the installation to supplement our existing 1.5kW solar system with a new 7kW system and a 20kWh battery. The team was thorough, professional, and committed to quality. I have complete confidence that they’ll be there if we ever need support or future enhancements. Highly recommended!

I would like to commend AR Energy for the excellent service we received in the design, quoting, and installation of our solar and battery system.I wanted to leave it for a week before providing my review so that I could analyse the power generation and storage capabilities combined with our daily power usage.Since the moment the system was powered on our household has not imported any grid provided energy, even with the dismal grey, cloudy and rainy days we have experienced over the past week.I commend Peter, Brandon and the excellent team of installers for the prompt, knowledgeable and very efficient installation.The team of installers arrived on time, were very courteous and left the site clean and tidy after providing me with all the information I would need to operate the app and the system. I did not have to do anything, all paperwork and applications were completed for me and the grid was connected.It was a pleasure to deal with them and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for their solar and or battery installation.

I commend the team from AR Energy that did the installation at my house. They worked efficiently and completed the job in one day, which surprised me, considering it involved removing an existing system and replacing it with 25 new panels and a new battery. The electrician, Nathan, put in a long day to get the system up and running, and everything was cleaned up and completed.I also want to thank Kurtis Fraus for providing timely responses to all our questions and changes of plans. It was a pleasure to deal with Kurtus.Because of our experience, we have recommended AR Energy to several friends who are interested in solar systems.Since the installation date, we have used no power from the grid, and everything appears to be operating as it should.

The AR energy was professional, easy to deal with. Price and plan of installation was sent before site seeing. That way I was able to research solar panels, battery & inverter that ware offered for installation. Installation crew was fantastic. 10kW solar panels & 20kW battery was up in one day and my roof was challenging. Also there was 3kW old system they have removed. Thanks to all involved. Great job!!!

I contacted AR Energy about adding more solar panels to my current system while also adding a home battery. James was very helpful throughout the quote process and provided plenty of options to choose from as well as answering all of my questions.Once everything was confirmed, Maddy and the team kept me updated and booked the installation, and Ryan installed everything smoothly, answering all of our questions.I've been very happy with the whole process and my new battery/solar system has been working wonderfully.

The quoting process was given in good time and provided more than one option. The installation took longer than anticipated but in the circumstances ( rain) was completed tidily by very polite friendly staff.Demonstrated operation of battery and app.Follow up issue with app resolved very quickly and to my satisfaction.

I couldn’t be happier with the whole process of upgrading our solar system and adding a battery. From the first quote from Kurtis, everything was clear and easy to understand  no pushy sales talk, just genuine advice and good communication.They showed up right on time, removed the old panels, worked efficiently, and left the place spotless. The team even replaced some damaged tiles under the old panels. It was clear they really knew what they were doing.The new panels and battery look great, and everything was up and running exactly when they said it would be. The installers were friendly and Jason expertly took the time to explain how the system works, which was much appreciated.Couldn’t fault them at all  professional, punctual, and easy to deal with. The system’s performing brilliantly already. I’d definitely recommend them to anyone thinking about a solar upgrade or battery install!

From start to finish, the team provided outstanding service for our solar panel and battery installation. Every step was handled with professionalism, clear communication, and genuine care. The installers arrived on time, worked efficiently, and left everything spotless once the job was done.They took the time to explain the system, answer all our questions, and ensure we understood how to get the most from our new setup. The quality of workmanship and attention to detail were exceptional.We couldn’t be happier with the results — our home is running smoothly on clean energy, and the system looks fantastic. Highly recommend this company to anyone considering solar — truly a five-star experience!

AR Energy were a pleasure to deal with from sales to installation to follow up. They have a highly professional team covering all aspects of the project, which builds confidence that they will be professional and helpful with any future needs if they occur. I have no hesitation in giving them the highest rating on all aspects.

From the initial quote from Kurtis to the install by Ryan and Kane this company provided a very professional service. The installers were punctual and had a high standard of workmanship. Being a sparky myself, I was very impressed.Upon completion Ryan explaned how the online app worked and who to contact if I required any future assistance.I would highly recomend this company to anyone contemplating having solar installed.Thanks again AR Energy Consulting.

AR Energy has been a dream company to deal with.  Starting with Aidan who owns the company coming and giving me a quote and talking through options over a couple of conversations, Maddy at the office sending out information and invoices and finally Blake and his team installing the Sungrow system.  Everything has been easy, seamless and highly professional.  I cannot fault them and look forward to a long association with them and their solar storage system.

I had panels installed by AR Energy and then 6 months later got batteries. Love it so much that my parents quickly followed and love their system as well. We have not had to pay for electricity since.I would like to say AR Energy is unique as they think outside of the box. They will really study how you use your power and make sure you get a system that fits your lifestyle and usage needs. My parents got a quote from another company as well and it was a completely different set up and size to what AR Energy suggested. AR Energy studied their type of useage and surmised that they would need additional panels, being a stay at home retired couple. They needed extra panels for their day useage while also some to charge their battery. The other company just suggested a battery size equal to the panels (This would have seen them never completely charging their battery).AR will look in to things more deeply when quoting. They have an excellent team of extremely professional and friendly installers as well as an amazing group of support staff behind the scenes looking after you.Highly recommend. There are so many dodgy groups out there so be careful. AR Energy are professionals and responsible, they are one of the few good ones out there. Highly recommend!

Brendan from AR Energy was great through the whole design and quote process, went over and above with educating me with technical info. Adding a three phase battery to an existing system meant comparing a few options and closely analyzing the cost vs benefit.The install process was very professionally completed, installers arrived on time and finished the job on time. A very neat install with minimal disturbance to us, left the site clean.Very very happy with the whole experience.Thanks you

We settled on AR because of their excellent customer service, consideration of our personal needs and limitations, technical explanations and flexibility right from the start. Due to a cancellation, they were able to install our system 2 days after we signed with them. Although our site threw up some initial challenges, the AR team found perfect solutions for all of them and were simply fantastic.

We started the process back in May 2025 looking to get a jump on the soon to be released Gov Rebates available for a battery installation.  We used Solar Quotes to seek out professional trades in this field and Solar Quotes response was fantastic in providing leads/installers.We made contact with all and James from AR Energy was very responsive to the multiple emails and changes in direction as the project developed.  He was genuinely interested in getting us into a system we could afford and still allow expansion down the track if we move into the EV world.From initially wanting to keep our old system and adding a battery, through site meetings and information emailed to us we opted for a complete new system including new 16kw rooftop, 3 ph 24kw battery and blackout protection system.The switchboard needed a large amount or reworking Come mid August we had confirmed what we needed and by early September we had a new mini energy plant fully operating - at levels we couldn't have imagined.AR Energy have been efficient, courteous and professional throughout the entire project - from James making initial contact and follow up, Maddie and Hazel scheduling and the install team of Blake, Ben and Jack leaving the site cleaner than what they found it!

We recently had solar panels and a battery installed, taking advantage of the federal government battery rebate. We went through Solar Quotes and had three installers quote for us. AR Energy were the best of the quotes, not necessarily from the price. The sales rep, James Richards, was easy to deal with; his input and knowledge was very helpful. After our initial quote, we wanted a revision, and that was no trouble. The installation went very smoothly run by Callan Banks the electrician. As requested, the installers added a shade cover to protect the inverter/battery from full summer sun. Our place was left tidy afterwards. Following installation we had the opportunity for a face to face with Nenad Tadic who helped run through the app and how the system works. This was helpful, as after a week or so, we had questions. The communication from the office staff (Maddy and Hazel) was timely and helpful.We were impressed with AR Energy and would happily recommend them.

My experience with AR Energy was excellent from start to finish. The sales and quoting process was clear and transparent, with all options explained in detail and the pricing broken down in a way that was easy to understand. The installation team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and were polite, tidy, and professional throughout the job, leaving the site clean once they had finished. Customer service has also been outstanding—they not only assisted with the grid connection after installation but also took the time to show me how to use the system properly, ensuring I felt confident managing it. Overall, AR Energy provided a smooth, professional, and customer-focused experience.

I have used this company on previous occasions and have been more than happy with the total process.They have acted in a very professional manner, and I would not hesitate to recommend them for any future requirements.The installation of a second battery went very smoothly. The installers arrived on time and were very polite and professional in every way. If you want a good job done this is the company, I recommend.

The supplier flew a drone over our existing solar. It was cracked. Supplier sent a quote for replacement solar which we forwarded on to our insurer. They sent an electrician who switched off the existing solar deeming it to be a fire hazard. This gave us confidence in the supplier - others gave cursory looks or didn't attend the property.The installation took over a week. The issue was the trench that had to be dug between the garage (power box) and the house (solar panels). The contractor with the digger was awful - took 2 days - machine problems, talking on the phone - ended up digging to half the required depth and leaving the job unfinished. The supplier had to lay the cable to a depth requiring it to be covered in concrete.Apart from this the supplier did a very good job, taking time to connect the system to the internet with cable rather than wi-fi for greater reliability; explaining how the system works and, mostly, cleaning up.Would recommend AR Energy.

AR Energy were fantastic to deal with.  I got quotes from 5 different companies.  AR Energy were competitive with price, and one of the contributing factors I ended up choosing them was that they were the only company to come on-site as part of the quote process to discuss and design the right system in person.  Being on-site, James clearly articulated the best placement of equipment and design.  The installers were punctual and clearly explained exactly what they were doing.  The site was left clean and tidy.  The system we now have is performing perfectly.

I chose AR Energy after reviewing three quotes. Although not the cheapest quote I felt it was the most diligent and informative. The quote was thorough and well detailed with no pressure to purchase which was appreciated. Installation was carried out professionally, with clear communication throughout the process. Contact with all staff was professional, punctual and friendly -  I would, and have recommended to others.

Chose AR Energy from 3 quotes even though they weren’t the cheapest, at least in part because of the professionalism of James, who provided their quote. Installation was carried out very professionally by 2 friendly open installers, with much consultation when a double brick wall turned out to be single. Clear explanations were given where necessary and the site was left spotless. Couldn’t be happier.

James was very informative and helpful during the quotation stage, helping me understand my requirements.AR Energy were more than happy to discuss and amend the quote to further upgrade the system per my request.From acceptance of quote to installation was surprisingly quick with a neat installation interfacing with existing solar panels with ease.Handover and instruction of use was explained in simple terms, I never felt rushed with all questions and queries answered. Received a follow up call about a week after installation to ensure I was completely satisfied or any further assistance required.Overall would highly recommend AR Energy and will be getting them back to install an EV charger when we finally get our new Electric Vehicle.

I couldn't find  a fault in the service received from the team at AR Energy if I wanted to. James in sales was great and wasted no time ensuring they were competitive and informative on the benefits of each option, as was Maddy in organising the install.Installation team were great, tidy and efficient, also happy to answer a couple of questions on the day. We were up and running by 3pm that day and have been very impressed with the system so far.Highly recommend.Matt

We had an absolutely fantastic experience with AR Energy Consulting from start to finish. From the moment we first inquired about a battery system, James was incredibly responsive and attentive to our specific needs. He didn't just try to sell us a generic solution; he took the time to understand our energy usage and recommended the perfect system for us—the Sigenstor battery by Sigenergy.The entire process was seamless and efficient. After we agreed on the plan, the turnaround time for the installation was remarkably quick. The installation crew was professional, skilled, and incredibly respectful of our home. They completed the work efficiently and left the entire area neat and tidy, which we greatly appreciated.After the installation, they took the time to walk us through the system, explaining exactly how everything works and ensuring we felt comfortable using it. The positive experience didn't end there—we also received a follow-up call to make sure everything was running smoothly and that we were happy with the results.We couldn't be happier with our new battery system and the exceptional service we received from AR Energy Consulting. We highly recommend them to anyone considering a new energy solution.

The quoting process was so easy and there was no pressure at all. The salesman Curtis was very helpful and even today is helping me while I consider adding to my battery.  The installing team were very good and quick. Nothing was too hard and they ensured to rubbish was left on site. They also set up the app on phone and stepped me through it so I understood what it was showing.I couldn't be happier.

I couldn’t be happier with my experience with AR Energy. From start to finish, the process was outstanding. Kurtis came out and explained everything clearly, answering all our questions and making sure I understood exactly what to expect. On installation day, the crew arrived on time and worked seamlessly together — true professionals who clearly take pride in their work. The whole experience was stress-free, efficient, and exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend!
Quotation was clear and I was given optionsInstallers where on time, polite and delivered a quality installation
Sales quote was easy no pressure installation done very quick after signing contract installation on time crew polite  and tidy explaned operation

Definitely recommend AR Energy i couldn't be more happier from start to finish everything was done seamlessly. Max and the crew did an amazing job (quickly and efficiently) and left everything clean and tidy. Well done guys.The best news is no more power bills. The system is working perfectly.

AR Energy were not the cheapest quote, however, Brandon was very knowledgeable and answered all my questions, and I believe he quoted for the right system to meet my needs.  The communication has been great!The installation was fantastic.  The lads who worked on my system were professional and courteous.  They left the site spotless.The engineer set up my mobile with my system and showed me how to use it and answered all my questions.I would highly recommend AR Energy

Can't believe that second time around the service was even more amazing. If you want the best service and products go with these lads. The office staff cannot spend enough time on the phone helping you alsoGreg

Sales/quoting was great - Brandon visited the site. We'd already done the research into our system requirements using SunSpot - Highly recommend the app by energy.gov.au.Installation was great - discussed with us prior to starting. Everything delivered on time. Proactive. Very clean. Very efficient.Explained the app.Everything worked once installed!Perfect job!

Friendly, price competitive, knowledgeable Sales staff (James) and installers, they turned up on time and worked solid for two days ensuring install was neat and all cables were concealed. They did a fantastic job and I would highly recommend the team from AR Energy!
Very happy with the process from start to finish. Minor issues were dealt with without question and resolved promptly. Everyone was very easy to  deal with. Highly recommended.
Good quality installation and good battery extended on existing system. Thanks

Never have I been more satisfied with a trade job than I was with AR Solar. From start to finish, the experience was smooth, professional, and exceeded expectations.James, the Business Development Manager has been fantastic from the get go—his communication was fast, clear, and informative. He made the process easy and gave me real confidence in my decision.The installation teams were punctual, efficient, and delivered high-quality work. Everything was neat, professional, and done right the first time.Nenad, the after-sales manager, was great also. He personally followed up to ensure everything was completed properly and that I was 100% happy with the outcome.Pricing was just as competitive as the other quotes I received, but the level of service truly set AR Solar apart.Highly recommend them—reliable, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to great customer service.
The quoting was great and he came to my house to look at it personally. Installation was great all the team were neat tidy punctual and funny and friendly.

From start to finish, my interactions with the people from AR Energy were top notch. This business was referred to me by a couple of people who had bought systems from them as well. Polite and attentive people who followed through with answers to any questions I had. Highly recommended.
We are so thrilled with AR Energy Consulting they were economical, efficient and kept us updated every step of the way. Would recommend them as the No 1 go to for Solar Systems.

The entire process from Brandon at AR Energy has been wonderful. So good in fact I recommended them to some family and friends for an excellent option if they were to consider a Solar Energy System.They are assisting me with a battery cappacity increase to the system they installed 18 months ago and we hope to take further advantage of the Federal and state battery rebates that are soon becoming available.Thanks AR Energy and Solarquotes for connecting us!

Given our installation was in a regional location, the cost and service delivered was as if we were next door.  From decision to installed and running was a matter of days rather than weeks.  The people from AR Energy were all easy to deal with providing friendly and efficient service.  We are very happy with our solar installation.

Really happy with our Solar experience with AR Energy, from beginning to end.  The sales rep was lovely to deal with on the phone; he clearly listened to what I wanted and quoted in kind.  What's more, he answered even my dumbest questions with a friendly, positive and informative attitude.  We were looking at purchasing a monster system with an equally monster-ish outlay to get us off the grid; the salesman helped us to feel confident in our understanding of what we were getting, and what we could expect.  The installation itself took three days as it included ripping out the old system before starting on the new. The boys doing the install were great to deal with, communicated very well and did so with a smile.  The batteries and control panel were installed in the garage against one wall.  It's all amazingly compact and neat.  The Sigenergy App on my iphone that tracks the solar is absolutely awesome - I look at it several times a day and get my jollies watching the batteries charge up to 100% and the energy start feeding INTO the grid.  In conclusion, everything just works - we are now effectively energy independent and I can't express how good that feels!

The whole process from initial contact to sorting quotes and assisting with finance was very simple and straight forward and sales person was very happy to answer phone outside of business hours to assist with any questions we had

I found AR Electrical easy to deal with.  The quote was prompt and realistic. They were not a local company but organised Installation quickly.The finished result was great and everything is running smoothly after a hiccup with the battery which wasn't releasing energy back to the house initially. AR Electrical returned a few days later and persevered to resolve the issue which in the end was a minor software problem. Everything is working great now, and I'm looking forward to a zero electricity bill!

From the time we email to get a quote the friendly staff at AR Energy have been profession and very helpful.Installation was very efficient and completed is less time than I anticipated.Kurtis was a great help answering all my question and explain the process from the start is as detail as I wanted.I would recommended Kurtis and AR Energy to anyone wanting to understand Solar and Battery packages.

From initial consultation to actual installation AR Energy were friendly, professional and sympathetic to my needs. The office staff kept me up to date with all information. The installers were so polite and aware of working within the area of a Retirement Village. They were quiet and friendly and so polite every time they had to enter my home. Definitely would recommend AR Energy for Solar. Thank you.

We spoke to Brandon over the phone and then he came to our house to chat about what our needs were and to go through various options, once we told him what we wanted to achieve, which was to have little to no power bills he explained the best option for us which was an 18-kw solar system with a 16kw battery storage Sigenergy system which was the latest on the market.Later that day he sent us a quote and information on the new Sigenergy system, and after doing some research on the system and AR Energy as a company we knew that we had made the right choice, we had other companies quote us over the phone from interstate but all of them were pushy and forever changing the size of system we needed.The day of the install we had around 8 people from AR Energy onsite and what impressed me was that they were all wearing the same uniforms which made them look tidy and professional, after speaking to some of them they all said that they work for the company and no sub-contracting, they were polite and kept the place very tidy and it was good to see that they take safety seriously as the guys working on the roof all had safety harnesses on.Once the system had been put through its start-up process, Brandon was on hand to explain the best way to use our solar system, such as using the dish washer and washing machine during the day as it will not cost anything to run, and on the very hot days run the aircon to cool the house down for later in the evening, he also loaded the Sigenergy app onto our phones so we could keep a track of our energy that was being produced as well as battery storage and lots more other information that the app offered.We are so glad that we choose to go with AR Energy as the experience was great from start to finish and what's more they are a local SA company.
Great all around. My mum is very happy. I would definitely recommend AR Energy to anyone getting a new install.

A&R were prompt in following up an enquiry and subsequently in providing a quote.They explained their design and took on board comments, making minor adjustments based on some of those comments.Being remote from the job, they communicated and coordinated with the tenant, gave a firm date to undertake the works and obliged in that.When a small issue arose on site a quick phone call was able to sort out the matter.It's just a pity the retailer is not able to act so promptly in making a connection.
Great to work with and helped me with the whole process

After a couple of years of procrastination, we bit the bullet and decided to use Choice mag’s recommendation of solarquotes.com.au to get 3 quotes from their list of vetted reputable installers to upgrade our solar system. Although only 2 got back to us (Solar Wholesalers and AR Energy Consulting), we were happy with both of them and didn’t bother chasing up the 3rd. We settled on AR, because of their excellent customer service, consideration of our personal needs and limitations, technical explanations and flexibility right from the start. Although our site threw up some initial challenges, the AR team (actual employees, rather than outsourced sub-contractors) found perfect solutions for all of them and were simply fantastic. I won’t elaborate, but for us, going with AR was a lottery win (and things like that just don’t happen to us!). Thank you so much, Aiden, Brandon, Sam, Joe and all of your team. Yours is the best company we’ve ever dealt with! And thank you Solar Quotes for helping us sort the wheat from the chaff.
All stages were completed on time and with no issues.
Service was amazing, made it easy to have the panels installed. Good explanation of how to use the app.
The most amazing company to deal with. A completely no stress installation on both properties. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for solar and/or batteries.

We live about 6 hours from Adelaide so we were happy to find an installer willing to travel and install a fairly standard solar panel/battery system. At every step we felt that AR Energy listened to us and so were able to provide the type of system we wanted. It took the team about six or so hours to complete the whole process from consulting about where everything would be placed to leaving the site clean and tidy. We were very impressed by the professionalism of the team and their generally 'sunny" disposition.All-in-all it has been a pleasing experience.
Great process from start to finish. Installers came on time and made sure to tidy up.

AR Energy were the only potential supplier to actually visit my home and survey the site prior to quoting. Discussions with Brandon during the quoting process were informative and fruitful. All my concerns were addressed to my satisfaction.The installation went smoothly, the team were polite, helpful and appeared very professional and competent. It was a good quality job, with all cables routed out of sight, through roof spaces and cavity walls. Commissioning went well, wifi connected and an App installed on my phone. The site was left clear and tidy.I would definitely recommend AR Energy for solar installation.

The quote included advice to upgrade and improve on our three phase power mains box. None of the others gave this advice. The quote was prompt and very informative. Requoted to meet our requirements. The installation by a team of 5 workers was done professionally. They were punctual and tidy everyday. Final commissioning by Aidan. Clearly explained how to operate the system. Very satisfied with the work and the system.

My experience with AR Energy was seamless from start to finish beginning with Brandon and his knowledge, professionalism and patience at my many questions making my choice of going with AR Energy an easy one.I had dealt with several other companies getting quotes and information but AR Energy impressed me hands down!Hazel and Maddy in the admin area were efficient, polite and a delight to deal with.On the day of installation Aidan was excellentin his attention to detail about the whole process of the installation and he and his team of Callan, Ben, Hayden and Lachy were just lovely. cheerful, friendly and polite and best of all....no mess, they did a great job of cleaning up afterwards.Aidan also set up the app on my phone and took time to explain how that works and how to use it so I understood.Brandon has also taken the time to  follow up with me to make sure that I was happy with how everything went on the day and more recently if I had any further questions.I would not hesitate to recommend Brandon, Aidan and the team at AR Energy.They have impressed me with their attention to detail, their professionalism and great customer service. Nothing was/is too much trouble.

The team did a great job with the install and the presales discussions really put them above the others we got quotes from. A few hiccups happened and they were very professional and customer focused, which was great to see
Fantastic customer service. Took the time to come out go through what I needed. Explained the system.

Great people to deal with, they were quick with the quote, very informative, started the installation 1 day earlier that they had scheduled, The installation guys were very polite & cheerful, they kept me informed, and they didn't leave any mess behind.Great job

Our project involved not just solar and battery, but the replacement of a gas storage system with a heat pump HWS, supply and installation of a dual head split reverse cycle air cond and installation of an induction hob. We extended this to a new oven and an outdoor shower. Not a simple job and AREC was the only respondent who came out to visit the site; they were also the only company who could provide everyting we needed - others only wanted to do only the solar/battery. The site inspection (and follow up visit) proved invaluable in working out where everything would be installed (not easy on a compact townhouse). After Aidan's visit the quote was turned around quickly. The time gap from acceptance to installation was short. The weather was on our side and the installation went very smoothly. The installation team, led by the very capable Max worked hard and kept the site tidy, cleaning up each day. We were lucky that we have side access via a laneway, which allowed a scissor lift to be used to get to the roof on the 2nd floor. Any changes were run past us during the installation, and we felt that each time we were able to agree on the best solution. To support the installation, we needed a new switchboard in our meter box and lots of additional cabling. All of the cabling/conduit ended up very neat, with things tucked out of the way as much as possible. Alll of the plumbing changes were routed very neatly as well. Everything was left clean and tidy after the install was completed - and they took away every bit of packaging that was brought in. We were given hands on explanation of how to control the inverter and isolation switches, but it may be helpful in future to add a system block diagram, showing the identification of the main switches and what position they should be in for different scenarios. We have certificates of compliance for the electrical and plumbing works. Our system is now operational and performing well: it is certainly performing at or above the quoted level. The phone app is very useful, but the PC/web version allows a much more detailed view. AREC have assisted with pre-filling the paperwork for upgrading our electricity account and we are now in the process of organising removal of the gas supply.

Excellent service before and during installation. Not pushy during sales/quoting, and very polite during installation.  Value for money: The same brands are used for the system components but are cheaper than other providers.

I considered four quotes (3 referred from Solar Quotes) to upgrade an existing 6kw system to include a battery. The age of the existing system precluded simply adding a battery so a complete new system was required. All suppliers were able to provide excellent advice and suitable options for consideration. Whilst all quotes were similar equipment wise and within a few hundred dollars of each other, I settled on the company that had the best reviews on this site. All interactions with the company were positive including initial discussions, quote, acceptance and timely installation which justifies their high rating. System is operational and exceeding expectations.

AR Solar have been brilliant, the system works great and they went above and beyond when dealing with upgrades needed by Origin. I’m extremely pleased and would encourage anyone to contact them, the stand out for me is that they did exactly what they explained they would, the plan went smoothly and I didn’t have to chase anyone which built enough trust for me to order more panels and batteries which are being installed in a couple of weeks. Thanks again to the guys at AR!

From the original phone call to seeing the site this was such an easy experience.The team of workers were efficient quick and tidy.Explained what was going on and how to work the system.Had no WiFi so got the dongle.No issues.Very impressed and happy. Would recomend them.Susanne

Yes terrific company, dealt with our energy retailer, installed on the day and time organised, great tradespeople who were communicative and explained the products, assisted in setting up the app and showing us how to read the data

After following the solar quotes process, selection of our installer was simple. AR Energy listened and quoted on the system upgrade we asked for. Fraser and Hazel were pleasant and efficient, and their turnaround time was relatively quick (we live in a more remote part of SA). All timelines and requirements were well communicated, and on installation day,  the job was seamless and efficient. All the people we dealt with at AR Energy were helpful and polite.
